score.label: No KFS and compounding penal interest

breakdown.label: One month penal interest at 24% on loan

summary_bullets: No Key Facts Statement, so the all-in cost stays hidden before signing.
A flat twelve percent rate hides processing fees and document charges.
Prepayment costs five percent and penal interest compounds monthly at twenty-four percent.

findings.title: RBI Key Facts Statement (KFS) Disclosure

benchmark.typical_label: KFS must be provided before loan signing

findings.quote: No Key Facts Statement is annexed to this Agreement.
findings.explanation: This is an NBFC loan, so RBI's KFS Directions require a one-page Key Facts Statement before you sign. The agreement states that none is annexed, which means you are signing without the sanctioned amount, all-in rate, fees and penal charges written down in one place.

negotiation_ask.short_title: Ask for the RBI Key Facts Statement
negotiation_ask.polite_ask: Could you share the RBI Key Facts Statement for this loan so I can see the all-in cost and fees before signing?
negotiation_ask.firm_ask: Under RBI's KFS Directions, 2024, a Key Facts Statement must be provided before signing. Please share it before I proceed.
negotiation_ask.replacement_wording: The Lender shall provide the Borrower with the RBI-mandated Key Facts Statement (KFS) disclosing the all-inclusive annualised rate, processing fees, penal charges and total cost of credit prior to execution.

findings.title: All-in cost and APR not disclosed

benchmark.typical_label: APR disclosed on an all-inclusive basis

findings.quote: at a flat interest rate of 12% per annum
findings.explanation: The loan quotes only a flat 12% rate. Once the Rs. 18,000 processing fee and Rs. 3,500 document charges are deducted up front, the effective annualised cost is higher than 12%. RBI requires the all-inclusive APR to be stated, and it is missing here.

negotiation_ask.short_title: Get the all-in APR in writing
negotiation_ask.polite_ask: Could you tell me the all-in APR, including processing fee and insurance, rather than just the flat rate?
negotiation_ask.firm_ask: The document quotes only a flat rate with no all-inclusive APR. RBI's KFS Directions require the APR to be disclosed. Please state the effective annualised rate including all fees before I sign.
negotiation_ask.replacement_wording: The Lender shall disclose the Annualised Percentage Rate (APR) on an all-inclusive basis, including interest, processing fees, insurance and any other charges deducted at disbursement, in the Key Facts Statement.

findings.title: Prepayment penalty on a floating-rate loan

benchmark.typical_label: No prepayment penalty on floating-rate loans to individuals

statutory_citation.act: RBI Circular — Prepayment of floating-rate loans to individual borrowers

findings.quote: the Borrower shall pay a prepayment penalty of 5% of the outstanding principal
findings.explanation: Foreclosing early costs 5% of whatever principal is outstanding, so on the full Rs. 6,00,000 that is Rs. 30,000. RBI bars prepayment penalties for individual borrowers on floating-rate loans; if this loan is fixed-rate, the charge must still be disclosed in the KFS.

negotiation_ask.polite_ask: Since this is a floating-rate loan, could the prepayment penalty be removed? RBI does not allow one for individuals on floating rates.
negotiation_ask.firm_ask: RBI's 2019 circular bars prepayment penalties on floating-rate loans to individual borrowers. Please remove the foreclosure charge in this clause or switch it to a fixed-rate loan with the charge disclosed in the KFS.
negotiation_ask.replacement_wording: No prepayment or foreclosure charge shall apply where the Borrower prepays a floating-rate loan. For a fixed-rate loan, any prepayment charge shall be disclosed in the Key Facts Statement.

findings.title: Penal interest is compounded or disproportionate

benchmark.typical_label: Flat penal charge, not compounded; no capitalisation

statutory_citation.act: RBI Fair Lending Practice — Penal Charges in Loan Accounts, 2023
statutory_citation.section: Penal charges not to be capitalised or levied as penal interest

findings.quote: penal interest shall accrue at 24% per annum and shall be added to the principal outstanding and compounded monthly
findings.explanation: A late instalment triggers 24% penal interest that is added back to principal and compounded every month, so the debt grows on itself. RBI's 2023 directions require penal charges to be a flat, reasonable amount that is never capitalised.

negotiation_ask.short_title: Cap penal charges at a flat amount
negotiation_ask.polite_ask: Could the penal charge be a flat amount rather than compounding interest added to the principal?
negotiation_ask.firm_ask: RBI's 2023 directions require penal charges to be a reasonable flat amount and not capitalised. Please revise this clause so penal charges are not compounded or added to principal.
negotiation_ask.replacement_wording: Penal charges for delayed payment shall be a flat amount proportionate to the actual loss caused by the default, shall not be capitalised, and shall not exceed the rate disclosed in the Key Facts Statement.

clauses.heading: Loan Amount
clauses.text: 1. Loan Amount. The Lender agrees to lend Rs. 6,00,000 (Rupees Six Lakh only) at a flat interest rate of 12% per annum.

clauses.heading: Interest and Fees
clauses.text: 2. Interest and Fees. Interest shall be charged on a flat-rate basis. Processing fee of Rs. 18,000 and document charges of Rs. 3,500 shall be deducted from the disbursed amount. No Key Facts Statement is annexed to this Agreement.

clauses.heading: Repayment
clauses.text: 3. Repayment. The Borrower shall repay the loan in 48 equal monthly instalments.

clauses.heading: Prepayment
clauses.text: 4. Prepayment. If the Borrower forecloses or prepays the loan at any time, the Borrower shall pay a prepayment penalty of 5% of the outstanding principal.

clauses.heading: Default
clauses.text: 5. Default. On any delayed payment, penal interest shall accrue at 24% per annum and shall be added to the principal outstanding and compounded monthly.

expected_clauses.label: Key Facts Statement attached or referenced
expected_clauses.why_it_matters: Without the KFS the borrower cannot compare the true cost of credit before signing.

expected_clauses.label: Prepayment and foreclosure terms
expected_clauses.why_it_matters: Undisclosed foreclosure charges can make an early payoff unexpectedly expensive.

expected_clauses.label: Grievance redressal and nodal officer
expected_clauses.why_it_matters: RBI-regulated lenders must name a grievance officer; without it, complaints have no escalation path.

spoken_script.text: ಈ ಸಾಲದ ಒಪ್ಪಂದದಲ್ಲಿ RBI ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸಿದ Key Facts Statement ಲಗತ್ತಿಸಿಲ್ಲ. ಸಹಿ ಮಾಡುವ ಮೊದಲು ಅದನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿ.
spoken_script.text_en: This loan agreement has no RBI Key Facts Statement attached. Ask for it before you sign.

spoken_script.text: ನಿಮಗೆ ಕೇವಲ ಹನ್ನೆರಡು ಪ್ರತಿಶತ ಸ್ಥಿರ ದರ ತಿಳಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಸೇರಿಸಿದ ನಿಜವಾದ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ದರ ಕೇಳಿ.
spoken_script.text_en: You are told only a flat twelve percent rate. Ask the real yearly rate with fees.

spoken_script.text: ಸಾಲವನ್ನು ಮುಂಚಿತವಾಗಿ ತೀರಿಸಿದರೆ ಐದು ಪ್ರತಿಶತ ದಂಡ ವಿಧಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ದಂಡ ತೆಗೆದುಹಾಕಲು ಲಿಖಿತವಾಗಿ ಕೇಳಿ.
spoken_script.text_en: Prepaying the loan early costs a five percent penalty. Ask for that charge to be removed.

spoken_script.text: ತಡವಾದ ಕಂತಿಗೆ ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತನಾಲ್ಕು ಪ್ರತಿಶತ ದಂಡ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ಸೇರಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳು ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದು ಸರಿಯಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿ.
spoken_script.text_en: Late instalments add twenty four percent penal interest growing every month. Ask for one flat charge.
